value.rationale: The paper leaves open a mathematically motivated basin question in an ecological/biochemical model where extinction and high coexistence compete. The explicit nonlocal geometric-mean criterion gives uniform avoidance of coordinate extinction, global convergence in a full-dimensional domain, and a sharp cutoff within that design class. This is not an arbitrary numerical slice, local stability restatement, or claim of exact full basin classification.
